# Changelog

## v0.1.0
- initial standalone vendor package
- wraps SpriteAsset89 v0.1.2 for GameMaker-style horizontal strips
- supports explicit or automatic `_stripN` parsing
- supports clean logical names such as `spr_x_walk` from `spr_x_walk_strip14.png`
- forwards image and render providers
- exposes GameMaker-ish `subimage` and `image_speed` helpers
